rank_meta.caveat: Research priority order, not a trade signal. No component has been validated against realised outcomes yet.

verification_meta.note: 'unconfirmed' means the configured feeds cover that event type but nothing matching was filed in the window - not that the claim is false. 'outside_coverage' means the feeds cannot see that kind of event at all (no 8-K/10-Q/earnings source is configured), so absence there proves nothing.
verification_meta.limitation: No catalyst event currently resolves to a ticker, so nothing can be confirmed. Catalyst articles are being summarised from headlines only, which leaves the model unable to identify the company. This is a pipeline gap, not a verdict on any claim.
